rules.requirement: Bounded GLB v2 (<= 2 MiB, declared length equals file length, JSON first chunk)
JSON chunk 1..262144 bytes, 4-byte aligned, followed by exactly one BIN chunk ending at EOF
UTF-8, strict duplicate-free JSON with finite numbers
Only reviewed top-level properties; asset.version 2.0; scene 0; scenes [{nodes:[0]}]; nodes [{mesh:0}]
No uri, extensions, images, textures, shaders, scripts, animations, skins or morph targets anywhere
Exactly one buffer with only byteLength equal to the BIN chunk length
At most 256 bufferViews and 256 accessors
1..8 materials with only name/pbrMetallicRoughness/emissiveFactor/doubleSided/extras
Each material has baseColorFactor[4], metallicFactor, roughnessFactor and emissiveFactor[3] in [0,1]
Exactly one mesh with 1..8 indexed-triangle primitives referencing existing materials
Attributes exactly POSITION, NORMAL, TEXCOORD_0 (float) with uint32 indices; tightly packed, aligned
Equal attribute counts; at most 32768 vertices and 32768 triangles; index count multiple of 3
Finite positions |v|<=1000, unit normals (|n|^2 in [0.98,1.02]), finite UVs |v|<=10000
POSITION min/max present and within 1e-4 of decoded data
Indices inside the vertex buffer and no degenerate triangles
Vertex normals lie in the front hemisphere of each triangle (winding agrees with normals)

rules.requirement: GLB of 28 bytes .. 4 MiB (byte identity is additionally pinned by the embodiment Definition)
GLB header and chunks: magic, version 2, exact length, JSON chunk then BIN chunk to EOF
UTF-8, strict duplicate-free JSON with finite numbers
No uri, extensions, scripts, textures, images or morph targets anywhere; depth <= 16
Exactly the top-level properties asset, scene, scenes, nodes, skins, meshes, materials, animations, buffers, bufferViews, accessors
asset has exactly version 2.0 and generator 'Finalverse blender-humanoid/1'; one embedded buffer
27 nodes, one skin, one mesh; scene roots [0, 26]; node 26 holds only mesh 0, skin 0 and name
Skin joints are nodes 0..25 in canonical order with 26 float MAT4 inverse binds
Joint nodes carry only name/translation/children; canonical names, bounded translations, canonical hierarchy, identity rest rotation
Inverse bind matrices equal the inverse global rest transforms within 1e-4
1..8 triangle primitives (explicit mode 4) without morph targets
POSITION/NORMAL/WEIGHTS_0 float, JOINTS_0 uint16, uint32 indices; packed, aligned, explicit view offset
At most 20000 vertices per primitive, equal counts, complete triangles, indices in range
Positions within 3 m, unit normals, joint indices < 26, weights in [0,1] summing to 1
Each primitive has a material with baseColorFactor in [0,1]
1..16 animations named from the 12 canonical clips, no duplicates
Each clip: 1..26 rotation-only channels on distinct joints with explicit LINEAR interpolation
Key times: 2..256 keys starting at 0, strictly increasing, ending <= 10 s; unit quaternion keys

runtime.title: Finalverse humanoid v1 strict E0 embodiment admission

rules.requirement: GLB <= 8 MiB with valid header (magic, version 2, exact length, JSON chunk)
JSON chunk <= 65536 bytes and 4-byte aligned
JSON parses with finite numbers
BIN chunk immediately follows JSON and ends at EOF
Exactly one embedded buffer (no uri) not longer than the BIN chunk
No required extensions
If nodes are present: exactly one node, mesh 0, no transform or children
Exactly one mesh with 1..256 primitives, no primitive extensions
Each primitive passes the FinalStorm strict primitive decoder (finalstorm_spatialdb::glb::decode)
Referenced materials exist; baseColorFactor and emissiveFactor (if present) are finite and in [0,1]
